name: Senders and Telemarketers registered with verification (Schedule-I item 1(4))

attrs.quote: The registration process of Sender and the Telemarketers by Access Providers shall include
attrs.scope: Senders and Telemarketers registering with an Access Provider
attrs.note: Registration includes physical verification of the entity, biometric authentication of its authorised person and linking the entity to a unique mobile number. Registration is with the Access Provider, on its ledger system (regulation 13).
